title: SAS Blueprint
description: Canonical blueprint record extracted from a real SFCC SAS promotion XML export. Separates frozen XML structure from editable per-season field values.

categoryCondition.description: A single <category-condition> node. catalogId and operator are frozen; categoryIds are frozen structural data.

priceCondition.description: A single <price-condition> node. operator and price are frozen structural gates.

conditionGroup.description: A single <condition-group> element. Contains exactly one condition node (category or price).

productConditionBlock.description: Represents <included-products> or <excluded-products>. Contains one or more condition-groups. All structure is frozen.

qualifyingProductsBlock.description: Frozen structure of a <qualifying-products> rule element.

excludedProducts.description: Present only when <excluded-products> exists in the source export.

discountedProductsBlock.description: Frozen structure of a <discounted-products> rule element.

excludedProducts.description: Present only when <excluded-products> exists in the source export.

frozenCustomAttribute.description: A custom-attribute whose value is structurally frozen and must not be changed between seasons.

value.description: For valueType=text: the text content. For valueType=nested: stringified inner value.

editableCustomAttribute.description: A custom-attribute whose value changes between seasons (user-facing copy or localized message).

value.description: For valueType=text: the editable text string. For valueType=nested: the editable inner value string.

nameEntry.description: A single <name xml:lang='...'> element. xmlLang is frozen; value is editable.

discountEntryTemplate.description: Frozen structure metadata for one <discount> entry in a product-amount discounts block. discountType is frozen; the corresponding threshold and value are editable.

discountEntryValues.description: Editable values for one <discount> entry. Paired 1:1 with discountEntryTemplates by index.

promotionSlotFrozenStructure.description: Every structural aspect of a promotion slot that is reproduced verbatim each season. These values must never be modified by the clarification flow.

nameLocales.description: Ordered list of xml:lang values present in the source <name> elements. Freezes which locales exist; editableFields.names provides the values.

discountFamily.description: Which discount element family this slot uses. This is frozen — it determines which XML elements the renderer emits.

simpleDiscountType.description: Present only when discountFamily=simple. 'percentage' or 'amount'. Frozen.

discountEntryTemplates.description: Present only when discountFamily=product-amount. One entry per <discount> element. Freezes discount type per tier.

qualifyingProducts.description: Frozen <qualifying-products> structure, or null if the element was absent in the source export.

discountedProducts.description: Frozen <discounted-products> structure, or null if the element was absent in the source export.

disableGlobalExcludedProducts.description: True if <disable-global-excluded-products>true</disable-global-excluded-products> was present. Null if absent.

maxApplications.description: Value of <max-applications> if present. Null if absent.

promotionSlotEditableFields.description: The small set of per-season values a business user provides for this promotion slot.

promotionId.description: The season-specific promotion ID. Updated every season.

names.description: One entry per xml:lang variant, matching nameLocales in frozenStructure.

simpleDiscountValue.description: Editable discount value for discountFamily=simple. Null when discountFamily=product-amount.

discountEntries.description: Editable threshold+value pairs for discountFamily=product-amount. Null when discountFamily=simple. Paired 1:1 with frozenStructure.discountEntryTemplates by index.

assignmentSlotFrozenStructure.description: Structural facts about a <promotion-campaign-assignment> that are reproduced verbatim each season.

customerGroups.description: Frozen <customer-groups> block outside <qualifiers>, or null if absent. matchMode and groupIds are frozen.

hasStartDate.description: Whether this assignment has a <start-date> element. Frozen: if false, no start-date is ever generated.

hasEndDate.description: Whether this assignment has an <end-date> element. Frozen: if false, no end-date is ever generated.

assignmentSlotEditableFields.description: Per-season values for a promotion-campaign-assignment slot.

couponIds.description: Editable coupon IDs. Null if the assignment has no <coupons> block.

startDate.description: ISO-8601 date-time string. Null if frozenStructure.hasStartDate is false.

endDate.description: ISO-8601 date-time string. Null if frozenStructure.hasEndDate is false.

blueprintId.description: Unique identifier for this blueprint version. Typically 'SAS-YYYY'.

sourceExport.description: Filename of the SFCC XML export this blueprint was extracted from.

extractedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this blueprint was extracted.

promotionSlots.description: Ordered list of promotion slots, preserving source-export order.

assignmentSlots.description: Ordered list of assignment slots, preserving source-export order.
